title: Signal: Possible a Shopify Admin API access token in source
scope: Single-line shape match for a Shopify Admin API access token.
limitations: Prefix evidence: Shopify's own developer documentation shows adminApiAccessToken set to an shpat_ value (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/shopify-app-remix/latest/guide-custom-apps, retrieved 2026-10-16). Body charset/length is NOT specified in Shopify's official documentation: the pattern lower-bounds the body at 32 alphanumeric characters (covering the observed 32-hex and 32-64-alphanumeric family shapes) and leaves the upper bound open so longer tokens are not missed. Bodies outside [A-Za-z0-9] or shorter than 32 characters would be missed. Shopify's shpss_ (app client secret) and shpca_ (custom-app access token) are different token types and are deliberately not matched.
fpNotes: Documentation examples using the shpat_ prefix with placeholder bodies (for example shpat_1234567890) are the common false positives; the 32-character body floor and the placeholder denylist veto them.
